_doc: Single source of truth for every Unreal data struct. C++ (Source/WalkTheArchive/Public/Data/WTATypes.h), the data converter (Pipeline/data/build_data.py -> WalkTheArchive/Data/*.json) and the editor setup (Content/Python/wta_setup/data_tables.py) must all match this file exactly. Field order = declaration order. Types: Name=FName, Text=FText, String=FString, Int=int32, Float=float, Bool=bool, Vector=FVector (cm, UE axes), Vector2D=FVector2D, Color=FLinearColor (linear, A=1), View=FWTAView, SoftTexture=TSoftObjectPtr<UTexture2D>, SoftClass=TSoftClassPtr<AActor>, SoftObject=FSoftObjectPath, Array<T>=TArray<T>. Bool fields keep the b prefix in C++ and JSON. JSON for a row: {"Name": <row id>, <Field>: <value>, ...}; Vector as {"X":..,"Y":..,"Z":..}; Vector2D as {"X":..,"Y":..}; Color as {"R":..,"G":..,"B":..,"A":1}; View as {"Location":{X,Y,Z},"Yaw":deg,"Pitch":deg,"bValid":true}; Soft refs as full object path strings ("/Game/WTA/Art/T_Art_ca_200.T_Art_ca_200") or "" when unset.

FWTAView.doc: A place to stand and look from. Location = the player's EYE position in cm (floor height + 162).

FWTABookBlock.doc: One block on a book page. Type is one of Para, List, Quote, Note, Code (FName).

FWTAWaxBeat.doc: One thing a reenactor does, from Time until the next beat (the last runs to the end of the loop and crossfades back into the first). Action names /Game/WTA/Characters/Common/Anims/Mocap/AS_WTA_<Action>, retargeted from Mixamo by Content/Python/wta_mocap. Yaw = degrees added to the figure's yaw while it plays; Blend = crossfade from the beat before, seconds; Lift = cm added to the figure's height. Authored in Pipeline/content/wax_acting.json.

FWTAWaxFigure.doc: A reenactor on a Wax Hall stage. Person = id in Content/Python/wta_people/people.json; its MetaHuman is /Game/WTA/Characters/<Person>/BP_<Person>. Offset = feet position in the stage frame, cm (X toward the aisle along StageYaw, Y to the right of X, Z up from the stage floor). Yaw = degrees added to StageYaw (0 = facing the aisle). Beats = what it acts out while the player is near; with none it holds one frame of the idle.

FWTAWaxPropKey.doc: Where a prop is at Time: held by Figure (a Person id) at Socket (head, hand_l, hand_r, chest) with Offset/Rotation in that socket's frame, or standing in the stage's own frame when Figure is empty. It travels to this key over Blend seconds, arriving on Time.

FWTAWaxProp.doc: A prop on a Wax Hall stage. WebIndex >= 0 names the web's own model for it, the mesh prop__<scene>_<WebIndex> of Props.glb (Kind then only picks how it sits in a hand); otherwise Kind (headset, tablet, clipboard, box, book, phone) picks a block. Kind static is a web carry the acting never moves, standing where the web left it.

FWTAStringRow.doc: The engine's own words in the pack's language: Key is the English the C++ writes (WTAText), exactly; Text what shows instead. The row name is just s0001, s0002, ... (the importer drops spaces, commas and quotes from row names, so the English cannot be the name). Empty table = English. From content/lang/<lang>/strings.json (WTA_LANG).

FWTAExhibitRow.doc: 15 gallery exhibits + the Freedom to Read board + the 12 Wax Hall reenactment cards (bWax). Location = centre of the artwork; Yaw = direction the artwork faces; Size = artwork width x height in cm.

FWTABookRow.doc: CatalogueUrl/CatalogueLabel: the client pack's catalogue search for this title (clients/<pack>/catalogue.json: search template with {q}); the cover shows the link when set.

FWTARoomRow.doc: Room boxes in cm (UE axes). Wing groups rooms (museum, wax, lib, school, play).

FWTAPlaceRow.doc: Say = how staff name the place mid-sentence ('the Wax Hall'); Directions = the answer to 'where is it' after 'That's '.

FWTATourStopRow.doc: Row name = stop number zero-padded (S01..S35). ItemId points at DT_Exhibits for exhibit stops. Action: '' | OpenItem | OpenBook | OpenStation | OpenRide | GoPlace.

FWTAStaffRow.doc: Location = feet position in cm; Yaw = facing. MetaHuman is set once the MetaHuman Blueprint exists (/Game/WTA/Characters/<Id>/BP_<Id>.BP_<Id>_C).

FWTAStaffRuleRow.doc: Preset answers that are fixed text (the web's presetAnswer branches, plus Pipeline/data/staff_rules_ue.py). Pattern is an ICU regex (case-insensitive) tested against the question. Order = priority (lower first; < 100 before the directions and title matches, >= 100 after; ties by row name). StaffOnly/StaffNot filter by staff id. Action: '' | GoPlace | OpenItem | OpenBook | OpenStation | OpenRide | StartTour | OpenBadges. bOffer = the action waits for a button under the answer, labelled OfferLabel ('' = a default for the action).

FWTATokenRow.doc: RideGate = ride id that must be running to collect it ('' = always).

FWTAWaxSceneRow.doc: StageLocation = front-centre of the stage floor; StageYaw = direction the stage faces (toward the aisle). Sequence = Level Sequence once authored ('' until then). Figures = the reenactors (web cast) on the stage.

FWTAStationRow.doc: Hands-on stations (sieve, titration, pendulum, bench, diorama, easel, the training wing's, the 360 storytelling course's). Steps = step titles and StepTexts the paragraph for each (the panel walks through them one at a time, read aloud as VO_station_<id>_<nn>; the last one finishes the station); Panel = the intro paragraphs. BadgeId = the badge finishing it awards (None = the room's: lab Lab Scientist, blueprint Model Maker, world World Builder, studio 3D Artist, training Trainee).

FWTATalkSlide.doc: One slide of a talk or class: what the screens show while the speaker says Say. Slide = the slide image (/Game/WTA/Slides/T_Slide_<talk>_<nn>, bl/slides.py); Clip = the line's voice id (/Game/WTA/Audio/VO_talk_<clip>); Seconds = how long the slide stays up when there is no clip.

FWTAQuizQuestion.doc: One multiple-choice question of a class's quiz. Answer = index into Options; Why = shown after answering; Clip = voice id (VO_quiz_<clip>).

FWTACertificate.doc: The certificate a class gives for passing its quiz: the visitor's name goes between Title and Line.

FWTATalkRow.doc: Talks, classes and courses (Pipeline/content/talks.json, or the client pack's own). Venue = the room the builders made (screen__<venue>, spot__<venue>_f<yaw>, seat__<venue>_*). Kind = talk | class | course. Person = the MetaHuman who speaks (a wta_people id); Staff = a staff member standing in as the speaker (hidden on their rounds while teaching). A class has a Quiz; answering PassCount questions right earns the Certificate and BadgeId. A course has no Slides: Stations are the DT_Stations ids to finish before its Quiz opens at the course desk (AWTACourseActor on spot__<venue>), Intro what the course lead says there (VO_talk_<id>_01).
